page.layout: One page of verse, one column, centred-left; below it a printer's ornament (bird on a base, no text); at the far right, outside the text block, the letters "A D" printed as a catchword-like marginal element. Running head at top centre; page number top left.

main_text.l: Et quanquam honoris contigit hunc gradum
Clarus per illa redditus ac potens,
Quod si ad Garumnæ littora Vasconis

page.notes: The first line of the page is a fragment of a poem continued from the previous page's sense, not a heading. Lines 2 and 3 of the first stanza: the word after "pectoris" is partly obscured by the printed letters and is read as "pectorisque" with the final letters doubtful; marked where the scan is unclear. The "A D" at the right edge is printed outside the text block (a signature-like or catchword-like mark), placed as a marginal note on the first line. The ornament below the text is a printer's device with no text. The "Quod" in line 8 and "Quoð" begin with a swash capital Q. The initial letter of "Quo celsius" and "Abs" are decorated capitals, read as Q and A. Several words in the lower-left of the margin behind the text are show-through from the reverse side and are omitted.
